(Japanese: '''カブさんのバトル修行''' ''Kabu's Battle Training'') is the 20th episode of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'', and the 1,252nd episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on September 1, 2023, in the United Kingdom on February 27, 2024, in Australia on March 26, 2024, in sub-Saharan Africa on April 19, 2024, and in the United States on May 10, 2024. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== Still in Motostoke, Liko and Roy are surprised to see Gym Leader Kabu at the Battle Café, but they’re disappointed when he leaves before Roy can ask him what he knows about the black Rayquaza. So they head to the Gym, where Kabu tells them that they need to become stronger if they want to eventually battle and catch Rayquaza. He leads Liko and Roy in a training exercise with their Pokémon, then challenges them to a Multi Battle alongside Wakaba, an aspiring Gym Trainer. The result is a fiery bout in which Kabu pushes Liko, Roy, and even Wakaba to give it their all—no matter what! ==Plot== [[Liko]] and [[Roy]] have just met [[Kabu]] at the [[Motostoke]] [[Battle Café]], where the [[Gym Leader]] compliments Liko and {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}'s {{m|Leafage}}. As Roy is about to ask about the [[Black Rayquaza]], Kabu goes for a run back to the [[Motostoke Stadium]], with Liko and Roy following behind. The two arrive and are greeted by {{OBP|Wakaba|HZ020}}, a {{tc|Gym Trainer}} apprentice. As Wakaba takes Liko and Roy to Kabu, she tells them that he's someone who works very hard. Liko also observes how much in common Wakaba has with Roy. The group meets up with Kabu at the battlefield, where he is doing some stretches. Roy and Liko ask about the Black Rayquaza, with Roy showing Kabu the [[Ancient Poké Ball]] it came out of, and Liko wanting to find out more about the [[Legendary Pokémon]] for bringing her as far as she's come. Seeing the resolve of the two young {{pkmn|Trainer}}s, Kabu puts them through a {{pkmn|training}} test to strengthen their partners' basic moves in creative ways. Liko and Roy must compete against each other to either extinguish or light up the flames on a group of {{p|Litwick}}, with the one who manages to do so on every Litwick present before the other is declared the winner. During the competition, Liko has Sprigatito use Leafage in different ways depending on how fast or tough their candles are to blow out. Kabu and Wakaba admire Liko and Sprigatito. Roy, noticing the score going down, has {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}} keep on using {{m|Ember}} at a rapid pace. However, Fuecoco soon tires out and gets hungry, so a snack break is taken. After Roy gets some reassurance from Kabu, the competition is resumed. Liko has Sprigatito use Leafage like before, while Roy and Fuecoco recover from their struggle, turning the tables on Liko lighting more Litwick candles. Liko sees a bunch of Litwick huddled up together, but after seeing Roy's renewed confidence, Liko stops to admire his progress for a crucial moment, which doesn't go unnoticed by Kabu. Sprigatito snaps her back into the competition, but when Liko turns around, she doesn't know which Leafage to use, which costs her the competition. Seeing how Liko and Roy are improving, Kabu challenges them to a [[Multi Battle]], with Wakaba as his partner. The battle begins, with Liko's Sprigatito and Roy's Fuecoco facing Kabu's {{p|Centiskorch}} and Wakaba's {{p|Rolycoly}}. Fuecoco starts with Ember on Centiskorch, but its {{a|Flash Fire}} [[Ability]] cancels it out. After an ineffective Leafage from Sprigatito, Centiskorch strikes back with {{m|Flame Wheel}} and {{m|Bug Bite}}, while an intimidated Wakaba can only watch. Liko commands Sprigatito to blind Centiskorch with a big Leafage and run in with Fuecoco using {{m|Quick Attack}} and {{m|Tackle}}, respectively. However, Centiskorch fires a {{m|Flamethrower}} straight ahead, blowing them back hard and leaving Liko afraid for her partner getting hurt. Roy sings with Fuecoco, giving the {{pkmn|category|Fire Croc Pokémon}} the strength to get up as Centiskorch charges for another Flamethrower. Roy commands Fuecoco to counter with Ember, but he uses a newly learned Flamethrower instead. However, Fuecoco is still not enough to overpower Centiskorch, whose Flamethrower [[Fainting|knocks him out]]. Seeing Roy's partner faint, Kabu leaves Liko to Wakaba, telling her to consider it her test to become a Gym Trainer. Sprigatito overpowers Rolycoly's {{m|Smack Down}} with Leafage. Next, Wakaba commands Rolycoly to use {{m|Rapid Spin}}, which Sprigatito dodges and hits Rolycoly with a sharp Leafage. Seeing Wakaba's frustration and determination to win, Liko suddenly forfeits the match. Upset by the possibility of winning by default without actually getting stronger, Wakaba runs off, refusing to become a Gym Trainer so easily. Kabu speaks with Liko about her hesitance stemming from her compassion for others' feelings, having noticed that she let Roy win in the training before too. He tells Liko that she is clearly a kind girl, but she must also consider how her opponent feels since they are trying their hardest to win. He also tells Liko to think of Sprigatito, who was also denied the chance to get stronger. Liko realizes how upset Sprigatito is with her and apologizes, then heads off to find Wakaba, who immediately apologizes for how she acted. Liko apologizes as well, telling her she hadn't fully considered her feelings. The two make up and Wakaba decides to make a fresh start and resume her training. Kabu tells Liko and Roy that he saw the Black Rayquaza several days ago during his morning run, flying over Motostoke before heading west, towards the [[Galar Mine]]. When Liko and Roy return to the [[Brave Olivine]], the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] decide to delay their planned trip to [[Hammerlocke]] to check out the mine first. That night, Liko is left in deep thought by Kabu's departing words, telling her that winning battles is not the only path a Pokémon Trainer can take. She begins to wonder about the path her own {{pkmn|journey}} should take. ==Major events== * [[Roy's Fuecoco]] learns {{m|Flamethrower}}. * [[Liko]] and [[Roy]] have an unofficial [[Multi Battle]] with [[Kabu]] and {{OBP|Wakaba|HZ020}}, with Roy losing and Liko forfeiting. * The [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] find out that the [[Black Rayquaza]] is at the [[Galar Mine]]. {{animeevents|HZ}}
